purpose: Two-step association smoke with a held-out relation split. Heads are selected using the first four anchor-to-fact links; queries evaluate the remaining four unseen links.

memories.text: Project Aurora uses the deployment profile called cobalt.
The cobalt deployment profile permits only two retries.
Project Atlas stores its records under the cedar profile.
The cedar storage profile is backed by PostgreSQL version sixteen.
Service Beacon follows the archival profile named amber.
The amber archival profile retains records for thirty days.
Job Comet executes with the silver worker profile.
The silver worker profile allows at most three concurrent workers.
Application Delta is assigned to the indigo hosting profile.
The indigo hosting profile deploys exclusively in the eu-west region.
Component Ember uses the cache configuration called violet.
The violet cache configuration reserves five hundred twelve megabytes.
Account Fable follows the credential profile named ochre.
The ochre credential profile rotates secrets every seven days.
Database Grove uses the backup schedule called teal.
The teal backup schedule starts each day at 02:00 UTC.

queries.text: Where is Application Delta required to be hosted?
How much cache capacity is allocated to Component Ember?
How often must secrets associated with Account Fable change?
At what time does the backup used by Database Grove begin?
